$comment: Single source of truth for all MNE-CPP public API classes and their provenance. Tracks where each implementation originates (mne-python, mne-c/SVN, scikit-learn, scipy, custom), where it is tested, and whether an example exists. Used for systematic porting coverage analysis.

classes.name: MNESourceSpace
classes.example_exempt_reason: Abstract base of MNEHemisphere and volume source spaces; used through MNESourceSpaces (ex_mne_api mne_source_spaces_usage).

classes.name: InvCMNE
classes.notes: CMNE (Dinh et al. 2021) — MNE-CPP original; deep-learning-enhanced inverse

classes.name: InvMxne
classes.notes: Uses IRLS internally, not direct sklearn MultiTaskLasso

classes.name: ICA
classes.notes: Custom FastICA impl; does NOT call sklearn directly

classes.name: BadChannelsLof
classes.notes: LOF algorithm reimplemented in mne-cpp; should be migrated to skigen

classes.name: Sphara
classes.notes: SPHARA — MNE-CPP original; surface harmonics for MEG

classes.name: DecodingCsp
classes.notes: Delegates to Skigen::CSP; adds MNE-specific transform modes (AveragePower/CspSpace), log/z-score standardisation, inverse_transform

classes.name: DecodingSpoc
classes.notes: Delegates to Skigen::SPoC; adds MNE-specific power feature extraction and transform modes

classes.name: DecodingSsd
classes.notes: Delegates to Skigen::SSD; adds apply() for denoised low-rank reconstruction

classes.name: MlIcaLabel
classes.notes: ICA label classification — neuroscience-specific, stays in decoding

classes.name: MlTensor
classes.notes: N-dimensional tensor for ML inference (ONNX Runtime interop)

classes.name: MlModel
classes.notes: Abstract base class for ML model inference

classes.name: MLTrainer
classes.notes: Orchestrates ML training via Python subprocess

classes.name: KMeans
classes.notes: Direct sklearn equivalent; should delegate to skigen

classes.name: StsCovEstimators
classes.sklearn: sklearn.covariance.LedoitWolf, OAS, ShrunkCovariance; sklearn.decomposition.PCA, FactorAnalysis; sklearn.model_selection.cross_val_score
classes.notes: Ledoit-Wolf, OAS shrinkage, PCA cov, Factor Analysis, auto-select via cross-validation — all reimplemented from sklearn; core algorithms should move to skigen

classes.name: StatsCluster
classes.notes: Cluster permutation testing — neuroscience-specific statistical method

classes.name: FwdCompData
classes.example_exempt_reason: CTF compensation wrapper that FwdBemModel builds for compensated coil sets during ComputeFwd; callers reach it through ComputeFwd (ex_fwd_api compute_fwd_usage).

classes.name: FwdThreadArg
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-thread work item of the parallel dipole loop inside ComputeFwd; built and consumed only by FwdBemModel, never by callers.

classes.name: FilterThreadArg
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-thread work item of the parallel source-space filter inside MNESourceSpace::filter_source_space; built and consumed only there, never by callers.

classes.name: MNEMghTag
classes.example_exempt_reason: Raw FreeSurfer MGH tag record kept by the surface reader inside MNESourceSpace; never constructed by callers.

classes.name: MNEMghTagGroup
classes.example_exempt_reason: Container of MNEMghTag records filled by the surface reader inside MNESourceSpace; never constructed by callers.

classes.name: MNEMshColorScaleDef
classes.example_exempt_reason: Colour-scale setting of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurface; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNEMshEyes
classes.example_exempt_reason: Camera state of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurfaceSet; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNEMshLight
classes.example_exempt_reason: Light of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurfaceSet; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNEMshLightSet
classes.example_exempt_reason: Lighting rig of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurfaceSet; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNEMshPicked
classes.example_exempt_reason: Pick record of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurfaceSet; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNENamedVector
classes.example_exempt_reason: Scratch record inside MNEProjOp::make_proj_bad that picks one projection vector onto the channel list; callers use MNEProjOp (ex_mne_api mne_raw_data_usage).

classes.name: MNENearest
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-vertex nearest-source record stored in MNESurfaceOrVolume::nearest; filled while reading a source space (ex_mne_api mne_source_spaces_usage).

classes.name: MNEPatchInfo
classes.example_exempt_reason: Patch statistics computed while reading a source space with patches; reached through MNEHemisphere::pinfo (ex_mne_api mne_source_spaces_usage).

classes.name: MNEProjData
classes.example_exempt_reason: Search-acceleration record (triangle activity mask) internal to MNESurface::project_to_surface; callers use MNEProjectToSurface (ex_mne_api mne_project_to_surface_usage).

classes.name: MNESurfaceOrVolume
classes.example_exempt_reason: Common base of MNESurface, MNESourceSpace and MNEBemSurface; used through those (ex_mne_api mne_bem_usage, mne_source_spaces_usage).

classes.name: MNESurfacePatch
classes.example_exempt_reason: Flat display patch of the legacy MNE-C mesh viewer held by MNEMshDisplaySurfaceSet; UI state with no computation to demonstrate.

classes.name: MNETriangle
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-triangle cache (centroid, area, normal) filled by MNESurfaceOrVolume::add_triangle_data; read through MNEBemSurface/MNESourceSpaces, shown in ex_mne_api mne_bem_usage.

classes.name: MNEVolGeom
classes.example_exempt_reason: FreeSurfer volume geometry header decoded from MGH tags by the surface reader; a field of MNESurfaceOrVolume, not built by callers.

classes.name: InvBeamformerCompute
classes.example_exempt_reason: Static numerical core (filter weights, power, regularised inverses) shared by InvLCMV and InvDICS; callers use those (ex_inv_beamformer inv_lcmv_usage).

classes.name: FiffExplainEntry
classes.example_exempt_reason: Row type of the static tag-name tables behind the show_fiff tool; not used outside fiff_explain.

classes.name: fitUserRec
classes.example_exempt_reason: Workspace of the Berg-Scherg least-squares fit inside FwdEegSphereModel::fwd_eeg_fit_berg_scherg; built and consumed only there (ex_fwd_api fwd_eeg_sphere_model_usage).

classes.name: CoilParam
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-coil dipole record InvHpiFit passes between its private fit steps; callers read HpiFitResult (ex_inv_hpi inv_hpi_usage).

classes.name: DipFitError
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-iteration residual record of the HPI dipole fit inside InvHpiFitData; internal to the fit (ex_inv_hpi inv_hpi_fit_data_usage).

classes.name: FitDipUserRec
classes.example_exempt_reason: Objective-function workspace of the dipole fit inside InvDipoleFit; built and consumed only there (ex_inv_dipole_fit inv_dipole_fit_usage).

classes.name: HPISortStruct
classes.example_exempt_reason: Sort key InvHpiFitData uses to match coil fits to expected positions; internal to the HPI fit (ex_inv_hpi inv_hpi_fit_data_usage).

classes.name: Pair
classes.example_exempt_reason: Internal index pair of the RAP-MUSIC source-pair search; only appears in protected InvRapMusic helpers.

classes.name: dipoleFitFuncsRec
classes.example_exempt_reason: Forward-field function table set up by InvDipoleFitData::setup_dipole_fit_data, never by callers (ex_inv_dipole_fit inv_dipole_fit_data_usage).

classes.name: ArtifactRejectionData
classes.example_exempt_reason: Internal per-channel scratch record of MNEEpochDataList::checkForArtifact; never part of a public signature.

classes.name: RegionData
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-region work item of the parallel clustering in MNEForwardSolution::cluster_forward_solution; built and consumed only there (ex_inv_api mne_cluster_info_usage).

classes.name: RegionDataOut
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-region result of the parallel clustering in MNEForwardSolution::cluster_forward_solution; consumed only there (ex_inv_api mne_cluster_info_usage).

classes.name: RegionMT
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-region work item of the parallel KMeans clustering in MNEInverseOperator::cluster_kernel; built and consumed only there.

classes.name: RegionMTOut
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-region result of the parallel KMeans clustering in MNEInverseOperator::cluster_kernel; consumed only there.

classes.name: FilterObject
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-channel work item of the parallel overlap-add filter in filterDataBlock; built and consumed only there (ex_dsp_filter filter_data_usage).

classes.name: RtCovComputeResult
classes.example_exempt_reason: Map-reduce partial result of the RtCov worker; callers receive the finished FiffCov (ex_dsp_rt rt_cov_usage).

classes.name: RtInvOpInput
classes.example_exempt_reason: Queue item RtInvOp hands to its RtInvOpWorker thread; built by RtInvOp::append, never by callers (ex_dsp_rt rt_inv_op_usage).

classes.name: FitUser
classes.example_exempt_reason: Cost-function workspace of Sphere::fit_sphere_simplex; built and consumed only there (ex_math sphere_fit).

classes.name: ReportSection
classes.example_exempt_reason: Private storage record of Report; sections are created through the Report::add* methods covered by the report example.

classes.name: SpectogramInputData
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-window work item of the parallel Spectrogram map-reduce; built and consumed only there (ex_dsp_spectral spectrogram_make).

classes.name: TaperedSpectraInputData
classes.example_exempt_reason: Per-row work item of the parallel tapered-spectra computation in Spectral; built and consumed only there (ex_math spectral_psd).

classes.name: BrainRenderer
classes.example_exempt_reason: QRhi draw backend owned privately by BrainView; it needs a live GPU device and is driven only through BrainView, whose example covers it.

classes.name: RtSensorStreamManager
classes.example_exempt_reason: Real-time sensor streaming state owned privately by BrainView; exercised through BrainView's streaming API (test_disp3d_brainview, test_sensor_streaming).

classes.name: SourceEstimateManager
classes.example_exempt_reason: Source-estimate loading and playback state owned privately by BrainView; exercised through BrainView (test_disp3d_brainview).

parity.$comment: Qualitative MNE-CPP<->MNE-Python parity map. Hand-curated data (NOT generated): each record classifies one public MNE-Python API against the pinned reference. Existing C++ classes above with a 'mne_python'/'python_equiv' field are auto-counted as implemented and need NOT be repeated here; this array captures APIs realised as CLI tools/methods, partial coverage, genuine gaps (missing), and out-of-scope (not-applicable). tools/parity/gap_analysis.py extracts the pinned MNE-Python inventory, checks every symbol is classified here or in 'classes', and renders doc/release/v2.4.0/mne-python-gap.{json,md}.

skigen_migration_candidates.migration_action: Replace math/KMeans with Skigen::Cluster::KMeans; skigen has kmeans++ and multiple runs
Refactored: BadChannelsLof delegates LOF to Skigen::LocalOutlierFactor
StsCovEstimators::pca() can delegate eigendecomposition to Skigen::PCA
StsCovEstimators::autoSelect can delegate CV loop to Skigen::ModelSelection

skigen_new_modules_needed.rationale: mne-python uses sklearn.covariance extensively for noise covariance estimation; critical for inverse solutions
FactorAnalysis for covariance estimation; FastICA as alternative to custom impl; CSP/SPoC/SSD are sklearn-patterned spatial filters
LOF for bad channel detection; BallTree for fast spatial indexing on meshes
